errors.text_span: 水平轴（X轴）则列出四个语体类别，从左至右依次为“新闻”、“传统文学”、“网络小说”、“微博”
errors.evidence: The description fails to mention the crucial subdivision of bars within each of the four main categories. Each corpus type on the x-axis is further grouped by gender ('男性' for male and '女性' for female), resulting in two bars per corpus type, not one.
The legend shows color swatches next to the names of the semantic domains, but it does not list their RGB color codes.
The description incorrectly states that the legend lists 16 semantic domains for both charts. While the legend for chart (a) has 16 items, the legend for chart (b) only has 12.

errors.text_span: 在图（a）中，柱状图的高度代表支配动词的总频次，其中“新闻”语体的柱状图最高，约达6800次，而“微博”语体最低，约1500次
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect because it ignores the gender subdivisions. In chart (a), the highest bar is for '微博-女性' (Weibo-Female) at 6793, not a bar from the '新闻' (News) category. The lowest bar is for '传统文学-男性' (Traditional Literature-Male) at 39, not a bar from the '微博' (Weibo) category.

errors.text_span: 在图（b）中，柱状图高度代表承受动词的总频次，其中“新闻”语体柱状图最高，约6500次，而“微博”语体最低，约1000次
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect because it ignores the gender subdivisions. In chart (b), the highest bar is for '网络小说-女性' (Online Fiction-Female) at 6526, not a bar from the '新闻' (News) category. The lowest bar is for '新闻-男性' (News-Male) at 97, not a bar from the '微博' (Weibo) category.
